text:
After a demanding start, thanks for your complaint, and we are sorry that your journey with Aurelia Skyways and your companion animal did not meet the standard of care you were entitled to expect. You have reported that the handling of the pet travel process caused avoidable stress and left you uncertain about the safety and comfort of the animal during the trip.

As the Companion Animal Travel Desk, we review matters like this with the same focus we apply to routine safety checks. We look at whether the booking path was clear, whether the handoff points were managed properly, and whether the care provided matched the guidance we expect staff to follow. Your experience suggests that one or more parts of that chain fell short, and that is not acceptable.

We want to reassure you that companion animal travel is treated as a shared responsibility across the service. The desk, ground teams, and cabin staff each have a role in preventing hazards, reducing confusion, and keeping owners informed. When one part does not work smoothly, the effect can be felt by both traveler and animal, and we take that seriously.

We have passed your report to the safety coordinator for review, with attention to handling, communication, and any missed checks. This review is intended to identify where prevention steps were not followed closely enough and what should be strengthened before the next journey. We also use such reports to remind staff that calm, consistent support is part of safe animal transport, not an extra courtesy.

While we cannot undo the disruption you experienced, we can say that your complaint has been handled as a safety matter, not only a service matter. That approach helps us learn from the event and improve the reliability of future travel arrangements for companion animals.

Thank you for bringing this to us and for giving us the chance to improve our service. We remain committed to safer, clearer, and more compassionate travel support.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
